title: Channel-Selective Normalization for Label-Shift Robust Test-Time Adaptation
venue: Proceedings of The 3rd Conference on Lifelong Learning Agents, PMLR 274:514–533
publication_status: Published proceedings record uses year 2025; record event/version dates separately if expanded
read_scope: Primary proceedings metadata and abstract only during approach selection; full method not read
method_overlap: Selective normalization channels reduce label-shift sensitivity; evaluates covariate and label shifts together on CIFAR10-C, ImageNet-C and fatty-liver classification.
limitation: Direct predecessor for imbalance-aware normalization. A simple SOURCE/normalization gate and showing normalization fails under imbalance do not establish novelty. Exact matched-concentration evaluation overlap requires full-method inspection.
